title: A video userpic's full-info ask is recorded before it is sent and never undone on failure
trigger: Premium user with a video photo is drawn while offline or a send fails: connect/contacts.rs:120 calls take_userpic_full_info_ask (inserts (user,photo)) and then send_json fails, or getUserFullInfo answers with an error (no handler unmarks).
effect: That user's userpic stays a still image for the whole session (state Unknown never asked again) until their photo id changes.
fix: Make the ask a per-photo enum (Asked{request}/Known) and remove the entry on send error or error answer.

title: loading_more is not tied to the request that set it, so a stale groups-in-common answer is taken as the first page
trigger: Load page 2 (loading_more=true), then trigger fetch_profile_chats for the same user again (retry/reopen) which removes the paging entry; page 2's late answer arrives with loading_more=false and replaces the list.
effect: After the fresh first page landed, the late page-2 answer replaces it: the panel lists only page 2's groups and `exhausted` is recomputed from it.
fix: Carry the RequestId in the Loading/Asking variants (as ProfilePhotosFetch does) and apply an answer only when its id matches.

title: refresh_chat_statistics drops the Loading entry while the old request is still pending and the new fetch is skipped
trigger: Open channel statistics, press Refresh while the first getChatStatistics is still in flight: the entry is removed, fetch_chat_statistics sees has_purpose_for_chat and returns Ok(None) without re-inserting Loading.
effect: The panel shows neither spinner nor data until the old answer lands (then it fills with the old result, ignoring the refresh); if that request is lost it stays empty. Same Loading-without-request-id shape in PollStatsFetch, InviteLinkFetch, JoinRequestFetch, AdminListFetch, ChatEventLogFetch.
fix: Give `Loading` the RequestId (like ProfilePhotosFetch) and have refresh replace it with a new Loading(id) so only that answer applies.

title: The 1024-place cap clears `files` and `asked` while the open chat still shows more places than that, so tiles are re-requested in a loop
trigger: Open a chat whose loaded window (up to 1500 messages) holds more than 1024 distinct locations/venues: each expect() at the cap clears the maps, the next pass finds the earlier places unasked and asks again.
effect: Tiles flicker to placeholders and getMapThumbnailFile is re-sent for places already answered, on every poll while the chat is open.
fix: Evict least-recently-shown entries (LRU) or only drop places not in the open window; never wholesale clear.

title: A story album answer creates the chat's album list when albums were never fetched
trigger: Create a story album (CreateStoryAlbum) in a chat whose albums were not loaded.
effect: stories.albums gets an entry with one album, which the album UI reads as the whole list.
fix: Store albums as Fetch<Vec<_>> and merge only into a Ready list.

title: Optimistic rollbacks restore the pre-request value unconditionally, except the topic mute and poll vote
trigger: Toggle a supergroup setting or pin a chat, an update (another admin or device) changes the same value, then the first request fails.
effect: The rollback overwrites the newer truth with the old value until the next update.
fix: Store the shown value in every rollback and restore only when the current value still equals it, as ForumTopicMute does.

title: updateChatReplyMarkup is dropped whole when its message fails to parse, leaving the old keyboard
trigger: A bot sends a new reply keyboard attached to a message whose content Quill's parse_message rejects (an unsupported or malformed field).
effect: parse_message(m)? fails the whole update (no @extra, so it is not recovered); the chat keeps showing the previous bot keyboard (or none) until the chat is reloaded.
fix: Parse only reply_markup and id from reply_markup_message, or degrade to message_id with no markup instead of failing the update.

title: An unparsable last message in updateChatLastMessage becomes 'no last message'
trigger: Receive a new message whose JSON parse_message rejects in any chat.
effect: parse_message(..).ok() turns the failure into last_message: None, which the reducer applies as the chat having no last message: the row's preview and date go blank until another message arrives.
fix: Distinguish 'null' from 'failed to parse' (Result or a separate variant) and keep the old preview on a parse failure.

title: A messageEffect answer that parse_message_effect rejects becomes Unknown, so the effect id stays 'requested' forever
trigger: Open a chat with a message whose effect TDLib describes with a messageEffectType* constructor Quill does not know (or with id 0). load_message_effects sends getMessageEffect and calls mark_requested(effect_id). The answer reaches 'messageEffect' => None => return Ok(None), so it falls through to EnvelopePayload::Unknown.
effect: The Unknown arm only logs. MessageEffects::requested keeps the id, it never goes to by_id or failed, and wanted() skips it from then on. The effect never plays and is never asked for again. is_gone() stays false, so anything waiting on it keeps waiting until restart.
fix: Return Err(ParseError::MissingField) for a messageEffect the parser rejects. recover_failed_response then sends the request a synthetic error and StickersPurpose::GetMessageEffect fails the id. Better still, keep the effect's lookup as one enum per id (Requested/Ready/Gone) in place of three sets.

title: Process-wide LAUNCH_CHATS stage is moved by any client's Ready, not the on-screen client's
trigger: Launch with two accounts where the background account's TDLib reports authorizationStateReady before the on-screen account has opened its database.
effect: The stage goes to ASKED for a page nobody asked for, so the first frame (macOS) blocks the main thread up to the 50 ms cap waiting for the on-screen page that is still far off; the design says a client still opening its database is not waited for.
fix: Key the launch wait to the client id that registered the on_ready launch request (store it in LaunchChats when load_chats_when_ready runs) and ignore other clients' auth states.

title: Style notices are not matched to the preview that asked: Added closes any open preview, Removed/Deleted closes any preview in Removing, and Removing has no exit on failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link of your own installed style, press Delete Style and confirm while the request cannot be sent (or deleteTextCompositionStyle fails). Or: press Add Style in one preview and, before the answer, a second preview replaces it.
effect: A failed or unsent delete does nothing visible (send result ignored with `let _`, DeleteStyle error is silent) and the preview stays in PreviewStage::Removing; the next Removed/Deleted notice from any request closes it. An Added notice for style X takes (closes) a preview showing style Y.
fix: Make PreviewStage::Removing/Adding carry the RequestId (or style name) and put the request id in StyleNotice; leave Removing on that request's error or a send failure.

title: Add Style has no in-flight stage and ignores a send failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link and click Add Style twice quickly, or click it while the request cannot be sent.
effect: Two addTextCompositionStyle requests go out (the second can fail with an error toast); a send failure shows nothing and the button stays as if nothing was pressed.
fix: A PreviewStage::Adding { request } variant that disables the button and is left on the answer, the error or a send failure (with the error toast).

title: A custom emoji id is marked asked on a send error and on send, and the UI never asks again if the lookup fails
trigger: Open the AI compose box while the getCustomEmojiStickers lookup for a style pill's emoji fails (network error) or resolve_custom_emoji returns Err.
effect: The style pill / editor / preview icon stays the Sparkles fallback for the rest of the account's screen; only an account switch clears emoji_asked. (Unconfirmed whether the driver's own lookup retries the id.)
fix: Do not insert on Err, and key the asked set to the outcome (Fetch per id, cleared on failure) so a failed lookup is asked again.

title: A link whose lookup cannot be sent does nothing and shows no error
trigger: Click a t.me link while the chats path is not active or the sender is closed (reconnecting).
effect: request_deep_link_info_from, continue_deep_link and request_deep_link_text results are dropped with let _ =; the queued link was already taken, the flow state is None, nothing is shown.
fix: On Err put the link back in the queue or set a StatusNote::error (Couldn't open the link).

title: An invite Join that fails to send shows its error box in the main window, not in the chat window of the invite box
trigger: Click a t.me/+hash invite link in a chat window, lose the connection, and press Join in the invite box.
effect: confirm_deep_link_invite's error arm sets DeepLinkState::ShowText('Couldn't reach Telegram.'), but Links::flow_window is set only on Ok(Some(_)). The next pump opens the DeepLinkInfo box with from_window None, so it appears in the main window, possibly hidden or behind. When the chats path is inactive (Err(InvalidRequest)), the session keeps InvitePreview while the UI copy was taken, so the invite box reopens with no message. Links::deep_link_invite is a hand-kept copy of ChatsState::deep_link.
fix: Set flow_window from the asking window before calling confirm, whatever it returns, and drop the UI copy: draw the invite box from ChatsState::deep_link, matched by generation.

title: A right-click link note outlives the right-click when no menu opens
trigger: Right-press a link where no message menu opens, scroll, then right-click another message at the exact same pixel
effect: right_clicked_link is only dropped by take_right_clicked_link or the next note, so the stale link's copy entry can be added to a different message menu at the same position
fix: Clear it on the next frame, scroll or chat change, or hand it to the menu opener within the same event.

title: A link tooltip stays on screen after the chat changes under the pointer
trigger: Rest the pointer on a text link until its tooltip shows, then switch chat with the keyboard (e.g. Ctrl+Tab / Alt+Down) without moving the mouse.
effect: The old link's address tooltip stays over the new chat until the pointer moves onto and off another link; nothing on the chat change clears message_ui.link_tooltip (only queue_link, note_right_clicked_link and the message menu do). Also LinkTooltip.shown is a Waiting/Shown stage as a bool.
fix: Keep the tooltip in ChatUi (replaced on chat change) with an enum TooltipStage { Waiting{token}, Shown }.

title: Link tooltip token restarts at 1 so an old timer shows a new tooltip early
trigger: Hover link A (timer starts), move off it (tooltip set to None), hover link B within the delay
effect: token = previous tooltip's token + 1 with None counting as 0, so both tooltips get token 1; A's timer fires first, matches B's token and shows B's tooltip before its own delay
fix: Hold the timer Task in the tooltip stage enum {Waiting{task}, Shown} so dropping it cancels the timer, or use a monotonic counter outside the Option.

title: closed_by_user is never reset, so activation logic trusts hidden() alone after the first close
trigger: Close the main window once (hide), reopen from the tray, later minimize it and Cmd-Tab (on a Mac where is_hidden_on_mac also reports a minimized window).
effect: main_window_on_activation sees closed_by_user true and raises the window the user only minimized, or does so when a chat window is the last active.
fix: Clear the flag in raise_main_window by making it part of the MainWindowState enum.

title: CLLocationManager keeps running after the picker closes
trigger: Open Send Location with permission pending or a slow fix, then close the picker.
effect: The task and receiver are dropped but RUNNING keeps the manager and delegate alive and updating until the next lookup or an answer; nothing stops it on close.
fix: Give locate() a cancel handle that stops and drops the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: A mouse-up lost outside the window leaves drag set and the map stuck moving
trigger: Press on the map, drag out of the window, release with the app deactivated.
effect: location_ui.drag stays Some, location_map_settled returns early on drag.is_some(), so the pin stays lifted, move_ended never runs, no venues or address refresh until the next click.
fix: Clear drag on window deactivation or on any mouse-move without the button pressed.

title: 'Warning confirmed for this run' resets on account switch
trigger: Confirm the IP-exposure warning, switch account, open another proxy link
effect: The one-time warning appears again; the field lives in the per-account SettingsUi although documented as per run
fix: Keep it in an app-wide struct (allowlisted) or document it as per account.

title: Proxy editor closes on 'request sent', not on TDLib's answer
trigger: Save an add/edit that TDLib rejects after the request was sent
effect: Box closes as if saved; the error only shows as Settings error text on the page behind
fix: Keep the editor in a Saving stage until the add/edit answer, close on ok, show error on err.

title: Emoji status access stuck in Granting when the toggle answer never comes
trigger: In a mini app, request emoji status access, press Allow (Premium); the toggleBotCanManageEmojiStatus request is dropped unanswered (stale-request sweep / reconnect).
effect: AccessStage::Granting has no timeout or other exit; every later web_app_request_emoji_status_access is answered 'false' as busy until the mini app window is closed.
fix: Give Granting the request id and a deadline (as PhoneFlow and SetRequest have) and leave it on a dropped request.

title: Mini app render_action is one slot; a second action before the next render drops the first
trigger: In one poll tick the mini app sends web_app_open_invoice and the user picks 'Open bot' from the menu (or two events arrive together).
effect: The OpenInvoice action is overwritten, the checkout never opens and the app never hears invoice_closed.
fix: A queue (Vec<RenderAction>) drained at render, or answer 'failed' to an invoice action that is replaced.

title: Mini app from_window is one per screen and overwritten by every later flow
trigger: Start a ?startattach link in a chat window (waits for getAttachmentMenuBot), then open any mini app from the main window.
effect: from_window becomes None, so the first flow's Add-to-menu box and notes open in the main window instead of the chat window that asked.
fix: Keep the asking window inside each pending flow value (PendingOpen/LaunchFlow) instead of one shared field.

title: Mini app open answers are applied in arrival order, not to the launch the user asked for last
trigger: Click a bot's menu button app, then quickly another bot's app before the first opens.
effect: Both launches stay pending; the first answer opens app A, the second replaces it with B (A flashes); if B fails A stays open though the user asked for B. Two answers in one 30 ms tick overwrite open_result, so A's launch is never closed with closeWebApp.
fix: Keep only the latest asked launch as current (drop older pending launches and close their answers), and make open_result a queue or keyed by request.

title: awaiting_toggle continues on any attachment-menu toggle answer, not the one it waits for
trigger: Accept 'Add to attachment menu' for bot A, and before it answers use 'Remove from menu' in another open app's menu.
effect: The remove answer (Ok) is taken as A's add answer and launches A's app; A's later answer is then a stray note.
fix: Carry the bot id (or request id) in awaiting_toggle and match the toggled answer to it.
